Following the FAO division of the oceans into major fishing areas, the catch data of {area} were analysed. The catch data are the FAO Global Capture Production statistics, release {release} {cite:fao_capture}, published by FAO on {release_date} and downloaded on {download_date} from {url}. They cover {first_year}–{last_year}, in tonnes live weight, and give the yearly catch of {n_countries} countries and territories and {n_species} species items in the area; aquaculture production is not included.
zh: 根据 FAO 对全球主要渔区的划分，选取{area}的渔获数据进行分析。渔获量数据来自 FAO 全球捕捞产量统计（Global Capture Production）{release} 版{cite:fao_capture}，该版本由 FAO 于 {release_date} 发布，本报告于 {download_date} 从 {url} 下载。数据时间范围为 {first_year}–{last_year} 年，单位为活重吨（t），包括 {n_countries} 个国家和地区、{n_species} 个物种条目在该海域的年渔获量，不包括水产养殖产量。

en: Species names, taxonomic levels and ISSCAAP groups follow the FAO ASFIS list of species. Definitions, classifications and coverage of the statistics are described in the latest FAO Yearbook of Fishery and Aquaculture Statistics {cite:fao_yearbook}. Coastal countries are those whose land, in the Natural Earth country outlines, lies within 20 km of the boundary of the FAO area.
zh: 物种名称、分类阶元和 ISSCAAP 类群采用 FAO 水产物种名录（ASFIS），国家、物种和渔区的中文名称采用 FAO 代码表中的官方名称。统计数据的定义、分类和统计范围参见最新的 FAO 渔业和水产养殖统计年鉴{cite:fao_yearbook}。沿岸国根据 Natural Earth 国界数据与 FAO 渔区边界的距离确定（20 km 以内）。

en: Breakpoints in the mean of the yearly catch were detected with the Bai-Perron structural change test {cite:bai2003,zeileis2003}, with a minimum segment length of {bp_h} of the series, and used to divide the catch series into stages. The catch series of the main species and countries were analysed in the same way.
zh: 采用结构突变检验（Bai-Perron 方法）检测年渔获量序列均值的突变点{cite:bai2003,zeileis2003}，各阶段的最小长度为序列长度的{bp_h}，并据此划分渔获量变化阶段；主要渔获种类和捕捞国家（地区）的渔获量序列采用相同方法分析。

en: Stock status plots {cite:kleisner2013} classify each species item every year as developing, exploited, over-exploited, collapsed or rebuilding, from its catch relative to the peak catch of its series. Only items identified to {status_taxa} were included, with at least {status_min_years} years of data, {status_min_consecutive} consecutive years with catch and a total catch of at least {status_min_catch} t.{status_smooth}
zh: 采用资源开发状态图方法{cite:kleisner2013}，根据各物种每年渔获量相对于其历史最高渔获量的比例，将资源状态划分为开发中、充分开发、过度开发、崩溃和恢复中 5 类。纳入分析的物种须鉴定到{status_taxa}，渔获序列不少于{status_min_years}年，连续有渔获的年份不少于{status_min_consecutive}年，且累计渔获量不少于{status_min_catch} t。{status_smooth}

en: Catches were smoothed with a three-year running mean before they were classified.
zh: 分类前渔获量经3年滑动平均平滑。

en: Trends over the last ten years were tested with the non-parametric Mann-Kendall test {cite:mann1945,kendall1975}, with its variance corrected for the autocorrelation of the catch {cite:yue2004}. For the main species and countries, the p values were adjusted for the number of items compared with the false discovery rate {cite:benjamini1995}, and trends with *q* < 0.05 are given as significant; the trend of the total catch is a single test (significant at *P* < 0.05). The mean annual rate of change was computed from the first and last of these years.
zh: 采用 Mann-Kendall 非参数检验{cite:mann1945,kendall1975}分析近 10 年渔获量的变化趋势，并对检验的方差进行了渔获量自相关校正{cite:yue2004}。主要种类和主要国家（地区）的 p 值按比较的数目以错误发现率方法{cite:benjamini1995}校正，*q*<0.05 的趋势视为显著；总渔获量的趋势为单次检验（*P*<0.05 为显著）。年均变化率按近 10 年首末两年的渔获量计算。

en: The diversity and concentration of the catch were described with the Shannon diversity index {cite:shannon1948} and the Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI) {cite:rhoades1993}: *H* = −∑*p*~i~ ln *p*~i~ and HHI = ∑(100*p*~i~)^2^, where *p*~i~ is the share of species item (or country) *i* in the catch of the year. An HHI below 1500 is read as unconcentrated, 1500–2500 as moderately and above 2500 as highly concentrated.
zh: 采用 Shannon 多样性指数{cite:shannon1948}和赫芬达尔–赫希曼指数（HHI）{cite:rhoades1993}描述渔获组成的多样性和集中程度：*H* = −∑*p*~i~ ln *p*~i~，HHI = ∑(100*p*~i~)^2^，式中 *p*~i~ 为第 *i* 个种类（或国家）占当年渔获量的比例。HHI 低于 1500 为不集中，1500–2500 为中度集中，高于 2500 为高度集中。

en: The {cmsy_top} species with the largest catch over the last ten years (items identified to species) were assessed with CMSY++ {cite:froese2023,froese2017}. From the catch series, a prior range of the intrinsic rate of increase r based on the resilience of the species in FishBase {cite:fishbase}, and priors of relative biomass from a neural network, CMSY++ fits a Bayesian Schaefer surplus production model, sampled with JAGS {cite:plummer2003}, and estimates r, the carrying capacity k, the maximum sustainable yield (MSY), and the relative biomass B/Bmsy and fishing mortality F/Fmsy of every year. Following the FAO classification {cite:fao_sofia2026}, stocks with B/Bmsy ≥ 0.8 are maximally sustainably fished and stocks with B/Bmsy < 0.8 overfished. FAO data have catches only and no abundance index, so the results are indicative. {cmsy_priors_text}
zh: 采用 CMSY++ 方法{cite:froese2023,froese2017}对近 10 年渔获量最高的 {cmsy_top} 个物种（鉴定到种的物种条目）进行资源评估。CMSY++ 根据渔获量时间序列、基于 FishBase 物种恢复力确定的内禀增长率 r 先验{cite:fishbase}以及由神经网络估计的相对生物量先验，拟合贝叶斯 Schaefer 剩余产量模型（采用 JAGS 抽样{cite:plummer2003}），估算内禀增长率 r、环境容纳量 k、最大可持续产量（MSY）以及各年的相对生物量 B/Bmsy 和相对捕捞死亡率 F/Fmsy。参照 FAO 的划分{cite:fao_sofia2026}，B/Bmsy≥0.8 的种群为最大可持续捕捞，B/Bmsy<0.8 为过度捕捞。FAO 数据仅有渔获量而无资源丰度指数，评估结果仅供参考。{cmsy_priors_text}

en: Catch shocks
catch shocks
shock detection
{shocks_methods}

Catch shocks were identified with the method of Cottrell et al. {cite:cottrell2019}: a LOESS curve (span 0.6) was fitted to every catch series ({shock_series}), years with a Cook's distance above 0.3 were flagged, and flagged years whose catch was below the median of the previous seven years were taken as shocks. Only series with catch in at least {shock_min_years} years were analysed.
zh: 采用 Cottrell 等的方法{cite:cottrell2019}识别渔获骤变：对每条渔获序列（{shock_series}）拟合局部加权回归曲线（LOESS，跨度 0.6），将 Cook 距离大于 0.3 的年份标记为异常，其中渔获量低于此前 7 年中位数的年份判定为骤变。仅分析有渔获年份不少于 {shock_min_years} 年的序列。

en: Catch shocks were identified with the method of Gephart et al. {cite:gephart2017}: a lowess curve (span 2/3) was fitted to every catch series ({shock_series}), years with a Cook's distance above 0.35 were flagged, and flagged years whose catch was below the mean of the previous five years were taken as shocks. Only series with catch in at least {shock_min_years} years were analysed.

en: Fishery collapses
fishery collapses
collapse analysis
{collapse_methods}

Fishery collapses were identified as defined by Mullon et al. {cite:mullon2005}: a catch series is the catch of one species (or genus) by one country in the area, and it has collapsed when, after its maximum catch, the catch stays below one tenth of the maximum for four consecutive years; the decline before a collapse is classified as plateau, smooth or erratic. Random catch series without trend were analysed in the same way to separate collapses from random fluctuations {cite:wilberg2007}.
zh: 按 Mullon 等的定义{cite:mullon2005}识别渔业崩溃：以国家与物种（或属）在该海域的渔获量为一条渔获序列，若在最高渔获量出现之后连续 4 年渔获量低于最高值的 1/10，则判定为崩溃，并按崩溃前的下降形态分为平台型、平滑型和波动型。为区分崩溃与随机波动，对无趋势的随机渔获序列进行了同样的分析作为对照{cite:wilberg2007}。

en: Synchrony of the catch and portfolio effect
zh: 渔获同步性与组合效应

en: the synchrony of the catch
synchrony analysis

The synchrony of the year-to-year fluctuations of the catch of the {sync_unit} was measured with the index φ of Loreau and de Mazancourt {cite:loreau2008}, from 0 (fluctuations fully compensating) to 1 (fully synchronous). The CV of the total catch is √φ times the weighted mean CV of the series {cite:thibaut2013}, and the portfolio effect is the increase of the mean CV of the series over the CV of the total {cite:carlson2011,ong2021}. The contribution of a series to the variance of the total catch is its covariance with the total divided by the variance of the total. Before the calculation, {sync_detrend} {cite:leps2019}; moving windows of {sync_window} years show the changes over time.
zh: 采用 Loreau 和 de Mazancourt 的同步性指数 φ{cite:loreau2008}衡量各{sync_unit}渔获量年际波动的同步程度，φ 为 0 表示波动完全相互补偿，为 1 表示完全同步。总渔获量的变异系数等于 √φ 与各序列变异系数加权平均值的乘积{cite:thibaut2013}；组合效应为各序列平均变异系数相对于总渔获量变异系数的增幅{cite:carlson2011,ong2021}。各序列对总渔获量方差的贡献为该序列与总渔获量的协方差除以总渔获量的方差。计算前{sync_detrend}{cite:leps2019}，并以 {sync_window} 年滑动窗口分析其随时间的变化。

Mean temperature of the catch
the mean temperature of the catch
the mean temperature of the catch (MTC)

The mean temperature of the catch (MTC) was computed as in Cheung et al. {cite:cheung2013}: the mean of the preferred temperatures of the species, weighted by their catch. Preferred temperatures come from FishBase and SeaLifeBase {cite:fishbase}; only items identified to species and matched in FishBase were used, and years in which these covered less than {mtc_min_coverage}% of the catch were left out of the trends. Sea surface temperature (SST) is {sst_name}{sst_cite}. Trends of MTC and SST were tested with linear regression and the Mann-Kendall test; the Mann-Kendall test was corrected for autocorrelation {cite:yue2004}, but the p-values of the regression and of the correlations do not account for it {cite:pyper1998}.
zh: 按 Cheung 等的方法{cite:cheung2013}计算渔获平均温度（MTC），即以渔获量加权的各物种偏好温度的平均值。物种偏好温度取自 FishBase 和 SeaLifeBase{cite:fishbase}，仅使用鉴定到种并与 FishBase 匹配的物种条目，可用渔获量占比低于 {mtc_min_coverage}% 的年份不参与趋势分析。海表温度（SST）采用{sst_name}{sst_cite}。MTC 和海表温度的趋势采用线性回归和 Mann-Kendall 检验，Mann-Kendall 检验进行了自相关校正{cite:yue2004}，但线性回归和相关分析的 p 值未考虑自相关的影响{cite:pyper1998}。
